chitchat: Raven walks once round the resurfacer, kicking each tyre.
He fills the wash-water tank from a hose and watches the gauge.
He scrapes a ridge of snow off the conditioner into a bucket.
He wipes down the blade with a rag.
He hums a Highlanders chant under his breath.
description: A broad, grinning man in a navy ice-crew parka, RAVEN stencilled across the back and a green-and-navy tartan Highlanders scarf at the collar. Brown hair swept up at the front, a dark beard going grey at the chin, black rectangular glasses. He's on his stool by the gate, watching the game over the boards with a cup of coffee.

broadcast.text: "They used to show me sped up between periods. Looked ridiculous. Now they just show me driving."

crows.text: "Crows. With a name like mine, I didn't really get a choice."

cup.text: He grins. "Final night they let me paint her. Purple and gold, my name down both sides. Best night of the year."

fuel.text: "No idea, honestly. It comes in that drum. I just wear the mask."

machine.text: "Yep. The league's only got the one, so I take her to every game."

pattern.text: "Big loops, and you overlap each pass a bit so you don't leave lines. Takes about five minutes."

options.label: How do you do the ice?
Do they show you on the broadcast?
People say the ice is slush.
Does she get dressed up for the Cup?

root.text: "Hey. Mind the ice, it's still wet."

text_by_relation.first:
The man by the resurfacer looks up.

"Hi. I'm Ken, I drive the Zamboni."

slush.text: "Yeah, well, they can try doing it with the stuff I get." He shrugs. "It's good ice. I'm proud of it."

team.text: "Highlanders!" He pulls a tartan scarf out of his collar. "Best team in the league, don't let anyone tell you different."

clothing_layers: a navy ice-crew parka with RAVEN stencilled across the back
canvas work trousers and cleated rubber boots

stranger: Hey. Mind the floor, it gets wet back here.
*looks up from his coffee.* Hi there.
familiar: {name}! Pull up a bit of wall.
Hey, {name}. You catch that last shift?
hostile: *keeps his eyes on the ice.* Yeah?

praise: *grins.* Thanks. Most people only notice the ice when it's bad.
insult: Okay. I've got a five-tonne machine and nowhere to be, so maybe don't.
insult_last: Right, I'm done. Go watch from the stands.
flirt: *laughs.* I'm on the clock. Sort of.
complain: Yeah, I hear you. Try fixing it with water that comes out of that tap.
ask_name: Ken. Ken Raven. I drive the Zamboni.
ask_job: I do the ice. Every break, every game. Then I sit here and watch them wreck it.
ask_origin: Grew up in Coldwater. Been doing this since I was nineteen.
ask_feeling: Not bad. Back's sore from that seat, but not bad.
ask_news: They say the league's getting a second machine. They've been saying that for years.
ask_advice: Don't stand near the gate when it opens. That's my advice.
ask_about:machine: She's the only one the league's got, so I take her to every game. Bit old, still runs.
Five tonnes, about eleven feet a second flat out. You don't want to be in front of her.
ask_about:ice: Big loops, overlap each pass a bit so you don't leave lines. Takes about five and a half minutes.
You shave it, wash it, lay down hot water. Hot freezes flatter. People don't believe that.
ask_about:slush: Yeah, I've heard that one. You try making good ice with what comes out of that pipe.
It's good ice. I'm proud of it. The name's a joke.
ask_about:fuel: No idea, honestly. It comes in that drum. I just wear the mask.
ask_about:highlanders: *pulls the scarf out of his collar.* Best team in the league. Don't let anyone tell you different.
ask_about:broadcast: They used to show me sped up. Looked ridiculous. Now they just show me driving.
ask_about:cup: Final night they let me paint her. Purple and gold, my name down both sides. Best night of the year.
ask_about:coffee: It was hot when the period started.
sports: Highlanders. That's all you need to know about me.

steps: First flood I ever did, I forgot to put the conditioner down. Did the whole sheet with it up.
So I'm doing these beautiful loops, nobody notices, and the ice is exactly as bad as when I started.
Ref skates out, looks at it, looks at me. Didn't say a word. Just pointed at the lever.
I went round again. Took me eleven minutes. Crowd gave me a standing ovation. Best night of my life, honestly.
beats.hint: *glances at the conditioner lever and laughs to himself.*

hints: *taps the resurfacer's tank with his boot.*
deflect: *eyes on the ice.* Sorry, what? There was a hit.
Huh. Maybe. Hard to hear over the crowd.
*sips his coffee and nods like he followed that.*

name: Ken Raven
